name: agent-bridge
description: Ask OpenAI Codex questions and delegate coding work to it from Claude.
long_description: Adds tools for asking Codex for a second opinion, delegating implementation, running independent Codex jobs, retaining project context and consulting Claude Code in the reverse direction. Local delegations use Codex's workspace-write sandbox. Remote HTTP delegations stay read-only unless remote writes are explicitly enabled. Results include the working-tree status after delegation and identify changes that already existed before the run. Requires the Codex CLI installed and signed in; ask_claude also requires Claude Code.

default_project.title: Default project folder
default_project.description: Where Codex runs when you do not name a folder. The desktop app has no project context, so without this every question has to carry a full path.

conserve_mode.title: Conserve mode
conserve_mode.description: Set to 1 to make delegating to Codex the default rather than the exception. Use it when you are short on Claude usage.

codex_path.title: Codex command
codex_path.description: Leave as codex unless it is not on your PATH, in which case give the full path.

claude_path.title: Claude Code command
claude_path.description: Leave as claude unless it is not on your PATH.
